title: Curious Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: This pearl-pale cuttlefish drifts close to the glass to study each visitor, then ripples looping, letter-like patterns across its skin, as if jotting down a thoughtful reply in a language no one has quite translated. Between conversations it patiently arranges sea glass into tidy spirals beneath the warm glow of a sunken brass reading lamp, and seems pleased whenever someone notices.
